maintenance_led.reason: Most revenue is propane fuel delivered to homes and businesses, a consumable used up; servicing and other energy lines are smaller.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are households, farms, restaurants, fleets and commercial businesses paying for propane; not government-funded.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes mainly from its existing propane customer base; it makes occasional tuck-in acquisitions, not as the main growth route.

mission_critical.reason: Propane is a commodity fuel; customers can change suppliers fairly easily, though tank swaps add some friction.

notes: Propane is largely a commodity but tank ownership adds some switching friction; also sells natural gas, electricity and fuel oil.
